title: AMC PR Admin Manifest
description: Single source of truth for PR ceremony level per AMC Simple PR Admin Model (SPAM-001 v1.2.0). Authority: CS2 — Issue #1163. Extended with execution_model per POLC_EXECUTION_MODEL_CANON.md.

type.description: PR classification type. Only 'product-fix' and 'docs-only' qualify for simple admin ceremony.

requires_iaa.description: Whether IAA final assurance is required. MUST be true for governance-control, agent-contract, migration, deployment, high-risk.

requires_ecap.description: Whether ECAP ceremony is required. MUST be true for governance-control, agent-contract, migration, deployment, high-risk.

scope_summary.description: Brief human-readable description of what this PR does.

created_by.description: Agent or user ID that created this manifest.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this manifest was created.

execution_model.description: Execution control model. REQUIRED when implementation files (apps/, src/, modules/, lib/, packages/) are changed. Authority: governance/canon/POLC_EXECUTION_MODEL_CANON.md.

implementing_agent.description: Agent ID executing the implementation. Required when execution_model is 'builder-governed' or 'foreman-orchestrated'.

orchestrating_agent.description: Foreman agent ID scoping and supervising the work. Required when execution_model is 'foreman-orchestrated'.

cs2_justification.description: Explicit CS2 justification text or issue/PR reference. Required when execution_model is 'cs2-hotfix-override'.
